ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Persistence Via Custom Protocol Handler
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects potential persistence activity via the registering of a new custom protocole handlers. While legitimate applications register protocole handlers often times during installation. And attacker can abuse this by setting a custom handler to be used as a persistence mechanism. Note: Unmapped fields: Details

sequences.query: (registry_path = RGX("^HKCR\\\\") AND Details = RGX("^URL\\:")) AND  NOT (Details = RGX("^URL\\:ms\\-") OR (process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)") OR process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\") OR process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\") OR process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\SysWOW64\\\\")))
